fields.executed_lat: number, 4 dp — the coordinate the drone actually flew (accepted within ±0.0001)
fields.logged_lat: number, 4 dp — the coordinate the command server recorded (accepted within ±0.0001)
fields.malicious_seq: integer — seq of the crafted command

note: A well-formed submission returns {"correct": true|false}; on a verified conclusion the body also carries the per-case incident_token. Coordinates are truncated to 4 dp on the wire.
